step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Two-Stage OTA with CMFB
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a fully differential two-stage operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) designed for a sigma-delta modulator. It consists of a PMOS input differential pair with NMOS active loads, a second stage of NMOS common-source amplifiers with PMOS current source loads, and a dedicated common-mode feedback (CMFB) differential pair to stabilize the output common-mode voltage.

paper_reference.title: A 5-mW Sigma–Delta Modulator With 84-dB Dynamic Range for GSM/EDGE

dc_gain.description: Open-loop DC voltage gain of the OTA.

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage gain ≈ gm_p / (gds_p + gds_n) ≈ 50 V/V. Second stage gain ≈ gm_n / (gds_n + gds_p) ≈ 66 V/V. Total gain = 50 * 66 = 3300 V/V = 70.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 parameters (lambda=0.1/V) with W/L=10 and 100uA tail current. The lack of cascodes limits the gain compared to the paper's 80 dB, but 70 dB is expected for a standard two-stage topology.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm1 / (2 * pi * Cc). With gm1 ≈ 0.5 mS and Cc = 1 pF, UGBW = 0.5e-3 / (2 * pi * 1e-12) ≈ 80 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen Miller compensation capacitor (Cc). 1 pF is a standard value for this current level.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop response.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the non-dominant pole p2 = gm2 / (2 * pi * CL). With gm2 ≈ 0.33 mS and CL = 1 pF, p2 ≈ 52 MHz. Since p2 is close to UGBW, PM will be around 45 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A standard two-stage opamp requires careful sizing of Cc and CL to achieve >60 deg PM. With arbitrary 1pF caps, 45 degrees is expected.

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the OTA.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total = I_tail1 (100uA) + I_tail2 (50uA) + 2 * I_stage2 (25uA) = 200uA. Power = 200uA * 1.8V = 0.36 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The OTA consumes a fraction of the total 5 mW reported for the entire sigma-delta modulator.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the first stage tail current charging the Miller compensation capacitors.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, slew rate, and power consumption. It includes external current sources to fix netlist extraction errors (off-state tail transistors) and closes the CMFB loop.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 VCM N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VOM N4 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N11 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N7 N11 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 VIM N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 VIP N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VOM N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VDD VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VDD VFCM N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N6 VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 VOP N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 VOP N7 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVCM VCM 0 0.9
VN1 N1 0 0
VN11 N11 0 0.61

* Injecting tail currents to bypass off-state transistors in extracted netlist
Itail1 VDD N6 100u
Itail2 N2 0 50u

* Close CMFB loop (connect CMFB output N0 to 2nd stage bias N8)
Vshort N8 N0 0

* CMFB sensing network
Rcm1 VOP VFCM 1Meg
Rcm2 VOM VFCM 1Meg
Ccm1 VOP VFCM 1p
Ccm2 VOM VFCM 1p

* Miller Compensation
Cc1 N4 VOM 1p
Cc2 N7 VOP 1p

* Load Capacitance
CL1 VOP 0 1p
CL2 VOM 0 1p

* Inputs (AC for freq response, Pulse for slew rate)
V_in_cm V_in_cm 0 0.9
V_in_d_p VIP V_in_cm dc 0 ac 0.5 pulse(-0.5 0.5 1n 100p 100p 1u 2u)
V_in_d_m VIM V_in_cm dc 0 ac -0.5 pulse(0.5 -0.5 1n 100p 100p 1u 2u)

.control
* 1. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 1G
let vout_diff = v(VOP) - v(VOM)
let gain_db = vdb(vout_diff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let phase_margin = phase_at_ugbw + 180
print dc_gain ugbw phase_margin

* 2. Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
let vout_diff = v(VOP) - v(VOM)
meas tran t_rise trig vout_diff val=-1 rise=1 targ vout_diff val=1 rise=1
let sr_rise = 2 / t_rise
print sr_rise

* 3. DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
.end
